title: 法律类案检索结果中性别偏置对用户认知的影响
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on gender bias within the Chinese legal system. The study created a user experiment framework to simulate a judge's process of reading relevant cases during legal case retrieval and is not an evaluation of a large language model. The key finding was that gender bias in the search results of legal case retrieval systems did not have a statistically significant effect on the sentencing decisions made by participants.
